svg.title: Inversion can leave an unbounded set
svg.desc: For added force2N, acceleration-difference intervals0.8..1.2,-0.2..0.2,-1..-0.1 map to masses5/3..5/2,10 or greater,and the empty set. An arrow denotes no finite upper bound.
